The impact of Freddy AI Copilot and Freddy AI Agent on service teams can be described through measurable improvements in efficiency, customer satisfaction, and cost optimization. Below is a detailed breakdown using relevant metrics:

1. Improved Agent Productivity (Freddy Copilot)
Freddy Copilot assists support agents by suggesting responses, summarizing tickets, and automating repetitive tasks.

25%–35% increase in agent productivity: Agents resolve tickets faster by using AI-suggested replies and auto-summarizations.

30% faster first response time: By providing relevant context and responses instantly.

20% reduction in average handle time (AHT): Agents spend less time on manual ticket triage and searching for solutions.

Example:
A team resolving 1,000 tickets/month could handle 1,250–1,350 tickets with the same headcount using Freddy Copilot.

2. Automation & Self-Service Efficiency (Freddy Agent)
Freddy Agent acts as a virtual agent, resolving issues without human involvement.

Up to 50% ticket deflection rate for common issues: Password resets, order status, refund policies, etc., are handled entirely by Freddy.

24/7 support coverage: No need for human staffing during off-hours.

40% reduction in human-agent workload: By resolving FAQs and L1 queries autonomously.

Example:
If a company receives 10,000 tickets/month, Freddy Agent could deflect or resolve ~5,000 tickets, saving hundreds of man-hours.

3. Enhanced Customer Satisfaction (CSAT)
10%–20% increase in CSAT scores: Faster responses and 24/7 support improve overall customer experience.

Consistent and accurate responses: Reduced errors in communication, leading to better trust and loyalty.

4. Cost Reduction
20%–40% savings in support costs: Lower reliance on live agents for routine tasks.

Faster onboarding for new agents: Freddy Copilot reduces training time with contextual assistance.
